_help: Единственный источник правды для сайта. После правки запустите: python3 tools/build.py. Поля со значением null показываются на сайте как «скоро». Подробности в README.md.

schedule._help: next_meeting: дата ближайшей встречи в формате ГГГГ-ММ-ДД, например "2026-12-01". time: время в 24-часовом формате, например "19:00". regular: как часто встречаемся. room: где именно в здании.

contact._help: Контакт для записи. Только то, что уже опубликовано на сайте прихода или что прямо дал о. Андрей. Личные телефоны участников сюда не пишем.

ui.site_title: Bodbe Brothers — a men's singing club in Orlando
ui.meta_description: A men's singing club in Orlando. Half the evening we sing, half we sit at the table. No auditions, no sheet music, free.

hero.title: Bodbe Brothers
hero.tagline: Half the evening we sing. The other half we eat.
hero.lead: A men's singing club in Orlando. No auditions, no sheet music, no experience needed. Just come.
hero.image_alt: Illustration: men singing together at a long candlelit table under a grapevine at sunset

about.title: A club, not a choir
about.body: Bodbe Brothers is a bunch of men who get together to sing and to eat. About forty-five minutes of singing, about forty-five minutes at the table. That's the whole plan.

nots.title: No auditions.
nots.text: Nobody will ask you to sing alone. Ever.

nots.title: No sheet music.
nots.text: We learn by ear, one line at a time, the way men have always learned songs at the table.

nots.title: No concerts.
nots.text: Nobody's putting you on a stage. We sing because it's good for us.

about.closer: If you've ever sung “Happy Birthday” at a party, you'll be fine. If you haven't, come anyway and sit next to someone loud.
about.image_alt: Illustration: men raising glasses of red wine over bread and candles

how.title: Three steps. No surprises.

steps.label: Gather
steps.text: Walk in, say hello, grab a coffee. Nobody expects you to know anyone. Someone will be waving at you.

steps.label: Sing
steps.text: A short warm-up, then one song, line by line. The leader sings, we sing it back. By the end you'll know a verse, maybe two.

steps.label: Sit down at the table
steps.text: Food, something to drink, conversation. This is where strangers stop being strangers. Sometimes the singing starts again.

how.image_alt: Illustration: men of different ages singing from sheets in a stone hall, an older man conducting

bodbe.title: Say it: BOD-beh
paras: Bodbe is a village in Kakheti, the wine country of eastern Georgia. Georgia the country, that is, not the state, though we hear Savannah is lovely.
Kakheti is known for long tables, homemade wine, and men who sing together in harmony late into the evening.
That's the kind of evening we're after. Hence the name.
bodbe.image_alt: Illustration: vineyard hills of Kakheti at dusk

songs.title: The first songs
songs.intro: Short, singable, and old enough that nobody remembers who wrote them down first. Recordings to practise with will appear here as we make them.

items.title: Many Years
items.text: The toast song: sung for birthdays, anniversaries and guests of honour. A handful of words; you'll be singing it by the second round.

items.title: Shen Khar Venakhi
items.text: A medieval Georgian song in three-part harmony. The title means “You are a vineyard.” Slow, and once you've heard it you won't forget it.

items.title: Christmas carols
items.text: Carols from the different homelands of the men around the table. Learned in the autumn, sung in December, see below.

items.title: Carols for people who can't get out
items.text: We'll take the carols to people in our community who are sick or elderly and can't get out much. A few songs at the door, a few minutes of company.

items.a: Most of us can't, officially. We learn by ear, in a group, and nobody sings alone. If you can hum along to the radio, you're in.

items.q: We meet at a church. Do I have to be religious?
items.a: No. This is a singing club, not a service, and nobody will quiz you on anything. Come as you are.
We talk in English. A few songs are in other languages; we learn the words slowly, line by line, so nobody gets lost.
Just yourself. And maybe a friend.

ways.title: Just come
ways.text: No sign-up, no list, no fee. Just walk in.

ways.title: Call first, if you'd rather
ways.text: Call the office and ask about Bodbe Brothers. We'll get back to you.

footer.note: Bodbe Brothers is a men's singing club that meets at Saint Nina Orthodox Church, Orlando.
footer.images_note: Photographs on this page are illustrations, not pictures of our members.
